lockFileMaintenance.description: Regenerating yarn.lock gets the hosted Renovate job killed, and the failed job stops all other Renovate updates for this repository (#4880). The lock file is maintained outside Renovate instead

customManagers.description: The composite actions set the Node.js version as an input default, which the github-actions manager doesn't read; look it up from the same source as setup-node in the workflows, so both move in one PR

packageRules.description: The Maven modules of Kompanion are built and used locally and never published, so there is nothing to look up

Wait two weeks before proposing an npm release, so broken or compromised releases are usually withdrawn by then. Yarn's npmMinimalAgeGate in .yarnrc.yml stays at one week: it also applies to security fixes and to packages added by hand, and must never be stricter than this, or Renovate would propose versions Yarn refuses
Match npmPreapprovedPackages in .yarnrc.yml, which Yarn exempts from the age gate

The tags of cypress/browsers carry the Node.js and browser versions (node-<node>-chrome-<chrome>-ff-<firefox>-edge-<edge>), which the docker versioning can't read. Order them by Node.js version, then Chrome major and build; stay on the Node.js major the CI uses. The tag doesn't fit into a 100-character commit header, so leave it out of the commit message; the PR body still shows it
Stylelint configs and plugins depend on the stylelint major through peer dependencies, so they have to move together, majors and minors in one PR
The Carbon packages are released together from one repository and depend on each other; @carbon/ibm-products has its own repository and release cycle
monaco-yaml and @monaco-editor/react must match the monaco-editor version they are used with

html-to-image 1.11.12 and 1.11.13 copy an SVG as a whole, without writing the computed styles of its elements inline, so the image export draws the canvas without its styles and the route group black (#2162). Stay on 1.11.11, but let later releases through: html-to-image.test.ts in packages/ui checks them
msw-storybook-addon depends on the msw major through a peer dependency
sass is an alias of sass-embedded, so both have to stay on the same version
Keep the React types in step with React (moved from the shared KaotoIO/renovate-config, only this repository uses React)
PatternFly packages are released together (moved from the shared KaotoIO/renovate-config, only this repository uses PatternFly)
Update all Storybook packages together, majors included (moved from the shared KaotoIO/renovate-config, only this repository uses Storybook)
